visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair wearing a light grey turtleneck sweater holds a light blue ceramic bowl filled with steaming white rice. She uses dark wooden chopsticks to lift a small clump of rice toward the camera. Large text overlays in white and red are centered on the screen against a blurred restaurant background with warm, dim lighting. (2) The scene shifts to the exterior of a restaurant named 'Zojirushi Gohan Restaurant' with a wooden facade and a blue fabric noren curtain at the entrance. A glass display case to the left shows various plastic food models of meal sets. (3) A sleek, modern white rice cooker is shown in a close-up against a plain background, followed by a close-up of thinly sliced roast beef garnished with green leaves and a soft-boiled egg on a blue plate. (4) A hand holds a printed menu card listing three types of rice with numbered circles, while another shot shows the exterior of Tokyo Station—a red brick historical building—surrounded by modern glass skyscrapers under a clear blue sky. (5) The woman is seen sitting at a long wooden counter table facing a large window that overlooks the Tokyo Station plaza. She is looking at a menu book. (6) A top-down view shows a full meal set being served: a plate of roast beef, a bowl of rice, a bowl of miso soup, and a wooden tray containing six small colorful ceramic dishes with various side items like pickles and vegetables. (7) Close-up shots highlight individual side dishes in the wooden tray, the steam rising from a bowl of miso soup, and the texture of the fluffy white rice. (8) The woman uses a white electronic sesame grinder to sprinkle seeds over her rice bowl. (9) The woman picks up a mouthful of rice with chopsticks and eats it, smiling and nodding with satisfaction while looking out the window at the evening city lights of Tokyo. (10) The final shot shows an outro graphic with pink and white elements, featuring social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, alongside a website URL and call-to-action text in Chinese.
